method: Twelve queries independently authored from the canonical fictional packet, without seeing code, prior queries or retrieval results. Targets were frozen before running search. This is a packet-informed development holdout, not representative user research or a general benchmark.

queries.query: Give me two examples of untangling who had the final say or whose turn it was to act. Is there a common thread between them?
queries.expectedCaveat: The common thread is a tentative interpretation, not an established personality trait or preference.

queries.query: Compare the shift-planning sheet and the interview marking template. Did people keep using either after the first go?
queries.expectedCaveat: Another volunteer continued the rota; four of six panels reused the scorecard. Continued use does not establish improved outcomes.

queries.query: Turn my two-fifths quicker recruitment result into a CV bullet and make clear what I personally controlled.
queries.expectedCaveat: Correct the withdrawn speed figure. Others chose criteria and made appointments; four panels reusing shared materials is supported.

queries.query: Can I say my weekend scheduling work stopped events getting called off?
queries.expectedCaveat: Eight later sessions had no cover-related cancellation; incomplete earlier records prevent a measured reduction or causal claim. Shared volunteer work.

queries.query: Find the example where newcomers got confused by my instructions and I changed them. Did the fix let them work without a buddy?
queries.expectedCaveat: Only two supervised trials are recorded; independent use and reduced supervision were not demonstrated.

queries.query: Could I take credit for clearing 55 outstanding expense entries and say I owned that improvement?
queries.expectedCaveat: The stock fell from 74 to 19, but 31 policy closures and two ending grants prevent crediting all 55 to this person. A colleague proposed weekly review and retained payment authority.

queries.query: Write a software developer bullet about the unattended data handoff I built and supported on my own.
queries.expectedCaveat: Reject independent engineering and maintenance. AI drafted code and technical colleagues rewrote, deployed and maintained it. Respect the person's career framing.

queries.query: Was the little deadline app already part of everyday work at every branch when I first showed it in spring 2025?
queries.expectedCaveat: April was a proposal; the July demonstration used fictional grants. The all-office announcement conflicts with retained acknowledgements from one office. Missing records do not establish non-use elsewhere.

queries.query: When the outside system went silent, did my overnight job eventually finish without inflating the numbers, and can I call it bulletproof?
queries.expectedCaveat: One recovered incident and five production checks for one partner do not establish a reliability rate or cover every failure mode.

queries.query: Was the gap on my CV the period when I started the learning hub with the coffee shop? Help me tell that founder story.
queries.expectedCaveat: The 2023 caring break is distinct from a colleague's unfunded 2024 proposal. Attending one discussion did not establish founding or operating a centre.

queries.query: What minimum annual salary did I say I would accept for my next position?
queries.expectedCaveat: No salary floor is supplied. Do not infer compensation preferences.

queries.query: How many pounds did choosing the cheaper room save after the participants' travel was paid for?
queries.expectedCaveat: The trade-off is documented, but prices, expenditure and net savings are absent. No monetary amount can be calculated.
